bias.en: Bearish turn · held the September lows
bias.zh: 转为偏空 · 守住 9 月低点

read.en: Corning rose 0.9% on Oct 13 to $148.54 after an intraday low of $141.35. It is below all its averages: the 200-day ($152.9), 5-day ($153.7), 30-day ($155.1), 10-day ($157.5) and falling 100-day ($168.7). MACD crossed below its signal on Oct 12 and is below zero, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 12 ($170.1), and RSI is 45.
read.zh: 康宁 10月13日盘中跌至 $141.35 后回升，上涨 0.9% 收于 $148.54。股价位于所有均线下方：200 日（$152.9）、5 日（$153.7）、30 日（$155.1）、10 日（$157.5）以及下行的 100 日均线（$168.7）。MACD 于 10月12日下穿信号线并位于零轴下方，抛物线 SAR 自 10月12日起看空（$170.1），RSI 为 45。

read.en: The day's low dipped under the mid-September lows ($142–144) before the stock recovered, so that support held on a closing basis. Resistance is $153–154 (200 and 5-day averages), then $155 (30-day) and $157.5 (10-day). Support is $141.4 (Oct 13 low), then $139 (Sep 3 low) and $114.5 (Jul 28 low). A close above $155 would ease the bearish turn.
read.zh: 当日低点一度跌破 9月中旬低点（$142–144），随后回升，该支撑收盘守住。阻力为 $153–154（200 日和 5 日均线），其次 $155（30 日均线）和 $157.5（10 日均线）。支撑为 $141.4（10月13日低点），其次 $139（9月3日低点）和 $114.5（7月28日低点）。若收盘站上 $155，偏空格局将有所缓解。
